answer.reason: Different business model: Wendy’s serves made-to-order restaurant meals through drive-thru and delivery and recruits franchise owners. Hormel makes branded food products sold in stores and marketed to foodservice. Shared exposure to food consumption does not establish comparable offerings or buying occasions.
answer.missing_evidence: Exact customer mixes are unavailable, but the passages establish the restaurant-versus-branded-food distinction.
